title: Awakened Subagent Frontmatter
description: Validates the parsed YAML frontmatter object of an Awakened subagent (plugins/bankai/agents/<name>.md). This schema is the mechanism SPEC C-2 names: it rejects bare and unrestricted tool grants mechanically rather than by review. The $id is an identifier only and is never fetched at runtime (HR-6).
$comment: R-4: the official Claude Code agent frontmatter field set is open-ended and is re-verified against the live docs at Phase 2 (SPEC section 0). This schema therefore declares only the fields Awakened policy constrains and leaves additionalProperties true, so a legitimate official field never becomes a merge-blocking validation error. Prohibitions are policy, not guesses: hooks (D-15 budget lives in plugin.json), mcpServers (HR-2), and permissionMode: bypassPermissions (C-2 - an agent that can bypass permission prompts has an unrestricted allowlist by another route). Whether permissionMode is even supported for plugin-shipped agents is an open assumption; the guard is written so it holds either way.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case agent name (N-3). Must equal the agent file's basename; that cross-check is enforced by scripts/validate.

description.description: What the agent does and when it should be dispatched. Trigger-bearing, not a label (N-2).

tools.description: Restricted tool allowlist. MANDATORY (C-2): an agent that omits it inherits the full tool set, which is a bare allowlist by another name. Accepts the comma-separated string form or the list form; both are checked against the same prohibition. Bare or wildcard-equivalent grants are rejected: *, Bash, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, and any parenthesised form whose argument is only asterisks, colons, dots, or whitespace - Bash(*), Bash(*:*), Bash(:*), Bash( * ), Bash(). Case variants and surrounding quotes are rejected too. Scoped grants such as Bash(git status:*) and Write(docs/notes.md) are accepted.

disallowedTools.description: Optional tool denylist. Belt and braces alongside the allowlist; it never substitutes for it.

maxTurns.description: Maximum agentic turns before the subagent must return. Optional, but budgeting it is recommended so a runaway agent is bounded.

permissionMode.description: If present, bypassPermissions is rejected: it would defeat the C-2 allowlist by removing the confirmation surface. Support for this field on plugin-shipped agents is unverified and is re-checked at Phase 2.

skills.description: Skills preloaded into the subagent context, as a single name or a list of names.
